why: Playful: the widest pitch swing on the punchline (20.9 semitones), light and bright, clearly a different man from Ren and Bex.
chosen_from: 12 auditions (4 per host) of the best-matching male voices among 60 LibriTTS-R speakers, each reading the host's line with Chatterbox Turbo

source.credit: Voice of LibriTTS-R speaker 908. LibriTTS-R by Y. Koizumi et al. (2023), CC BY 4.0, derived from LibriTTS (H. Zen et al.) and LibriSpeech/LibriVox recordings.

voice_check: Every new line is compared with reference.wav (WeSpeaker voiceprint) and voiced again, steadier, if it scores under 0.70.
